newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan truckers strike over toll roads.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan truckers strike over toll roads.

text.p: Truck drivers throughout Venezuela launched an 18-hour strike Monday in protest over the proliferation of highway toll booths, union leaders said.
"The costs of these tolls will be passed on to the people which will mean higher inflation," said Vicente Linares, president of the transport chamber in western Zulia state.
Union leaders said the strike call, which ends at 6 p.m. (2200 GMT), was being followed by 80 percent of truck drivers.
The strike follows a series of protests against a sharp increase in tolls on the expressway connecting Caracas with the country's main port.
Truckers have said the new tolls set by new concession holder Asoven, which is controlled by Mexican construction giant Empresas ICA, are excessive and many have refused to pay.
The truckers also said local governments have set up new toll booths on many roads without carrying out any improvements to the highways or providing alternative, free-of-charge routes.
